start.welcome_new:
Hi {name}! I'm Kibo, your personal productivity assistant.

Let's get you set up — it only takes a minute.
onboarding.location.prompt: Now, where are you? Share your location (for weather and your local time) or just type your city name.
location.city_not_found: I couldn't find that city. Try typing it differently (e.g. "Barcelona" or "Boston, US").
onboarding.briefing.prompt: When would you like your daily briefing?
briefing.custom_prompt: Send me a time in HH:MM format (24h), e.g. 08:30.
briefing.invalid_time: That doesn't look like a valid time. Send it as HH:MM, e.g. 08:30.
onboarding.topics.prompt: Pick the news topics for your briefing (tap to toggle, then Done):
onboarding.google.prompt: Want to connect Google Calendar and Google Tasks now? You can also do this later from Settings.
google.placeholder: Google connection is coming in the next phase (F2). Continuing without it for now.
menu.title: Main menu — what would you like to do?
menu.placeholder: Not available yet — coming in a future update.
placeholder.today: Not available yet — coming in a future update.
placeholder.tasks: Not available yet — coming in a future update.
text.hint_use_menu: I don't understand free text yet — try /menu.
